title: Control Volume System
text: Constant volume open thermodynamic system with heat transfer, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Heat transfer model} sets Select model; {Number of inlet ports} sets the number of ports, {Number of outlet ports} sets the number of ports, {Image type} sets the icon color, {Chamber volume, Vch} sets the volume, {Initial chamber pressure, Pinit} sets the pressure, {Initial chamber temperature, Tinit} sets the temperature, {Ideal gas constant, R}, {Specific heat capacity, cp}, {Heat transfer rate, q_he} sets the rate, {External convection heat transfer coefficient, ext_tbl} sets the manifold external air, {External velocity breakpoints, ext_bpts} sets the manifold external air linspace, {External convection area, Aext_conv} sets the manifold external air, {Thermal mass, m_wall} sets the manifold wall general, {Wall heat capacity, cp_wall} sets the manifold wall general, {Initial mass temperature, Tmass} sets the manifold wall general, {External wall thickness, Dext_cond} sets the manifold wall external, {External conduction area, Aext_cond} sets the manifold wall external, {External wall thermal conductivity, kext} sets the manifold wall external, {Internal wall thickness, Dint_cond} sets the manifold wall internal, {Internal conduction area, Aint_cond} sets the manifold wall internal, {Internal wall thermal conductivity, kint} sets the manifold wall internal, {Internal convection heat transfer coefficient, int_tbl} sets the manifold internal air, {Internal mass flow rate breakpoints, int_bpts} sets the manifold internal air linspace and {Internal flow convection area, Aint_conv} sets the manifold internal air. Values come from the instance.
